thesis: The guest uses movies like 'Whiplash' as a coded screening tactic to distinguish between candidates who have an adversarial relationship with their work and those who view their work as an inspirational pursuit. He argues that in creative fields where the performance tail is significantly larger than the median, it is essential to identify individuals who are deeply interested in the job rather than those who aim to do the minimum amount possible.
